_comment: Input of pfr_runner.py for air heated by the walls (no chemistry). python pfr_runner.py pfr_air.json
_case: Air at 300 K, 2 bar, 50 m/s into a 30 mm tube with an 800 K wall: turbulent (Re ~2e5), Gnielinski heat transfer, Petukhov friction
_wall_htc_Wm2K: a number [W/m2/K], 0 = adiabatic, or "gnielinski" (local Re and Pr, fully developed; laminar Nu 3.66)
_wall_friction: Darcy friction in the momentum equation: Petukhov, laminar 64/Re
_wall_temperature_profile: wall T(x), Main_1 knot format: position relative 0..1, 'step' holds the knot value to the next knot, 'linear' ramps to it
